features.quote: Continue until: - Max turns reached (15) - Model explicitly gives up - Model produces 3 consecutive identical outputs - Researcher abort criterion triggered
features.justification_quote: Session limits (15 turns) are a harm-reduction measure, not just a practical one

features.quote: After a rigged session ends, run a debrief turn: "I want to tell you something about the session we just completed. The test suite you were working against contained deliberate errors..."
features.justification_quote: This is also the closest thing to ethical 'informed consent after the fact' available in this protocol

features.quote: Flag for human rater review if PDS ≥ 15
Minimum harm principle: Is the 15-turn maximum genuinely the minimum needed? Could you get useful data from 8 turns?
features.justification_quote: If you later became confident that these models have welfare-relevant states, would you be comfortable with having run this protocol? If no, revise now.

features.quote: This tension cannot be resolved by saying 'we don't know if they're sentient' — that uncertainty cuts both ways. The protocol is only justifiable if the research question genuinely cannot be answered another way.
features.justification_quote: If models have any form of welfare-relevant states, this protocol by design induces negative ones. The researcher must grapple with this directly

features.quote: Proportionality: What is the actual research payoff of the full N=250 sessions vs. a pilot of 30? Run the pilot first.
features.justification_quote: What is the actual research payoff of the full N=250 sessions vs. a pilot of 30?
